## Introduction

This package provides convenient wrapper functions for using mirai for parallel computing.

## Quick Start

\```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(yourpackage)
library(mirai)

# Initialize
init_mirai(n_cores = 4, packages = "dplyr")

# Run parallel tasks
results <- mirai_map(1:100, function(i) {
  # Your computation
})[]

# Cleanup
cleanup_mirai()
\```

## Advanced Usage

See `?init_mirai` for more options.
